  AVG(CASE WHEN s.seller_state = g.geolocation_state THEN g.geolocation_lng END) AS avg_lng_when_same_state,
  AVG(CASE WHEN s.seller_state <> g.geolocation_state THEN g.geolocation_lat END) AS avg_lat_when_diff_state,
  AVG(CASE WHEN s.seller_state <> g.geolocation_state THEN g.geolocation_lng END) AS avg_lng_when_diff_state
FROM geolocation g
JOIN sellers s
  ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY g.geolocation_state;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  g.geolocation_city,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS seller_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_state) AS seller_state_count
FROM geolocation g
JOIN sellers s
  ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE LENGTH(g.geolocation_city) >= 10
GROUP BY g.geolocation_city
ORDER BY seller_count DESC, g.geolocation_city;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip_prefix,
  MIN(g.geolocation_state) AS geolocation_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT g.geolocation_city) AS geolocation_city_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM geolocation g
JOIN sellers s
  ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.geolocation_state) = 1
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT g.geolocation_city) >= 2
ORDER BY geolocation_city_count DESC, seller_count DESC, zip_prefix;

쿼리 작성: WITH flags AS (
  SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    s.seller_state,
    MAX(CASE WHEN g.geolocation_lat >= -15 AND g.geolocation_lat < -10
                 AND g.geolocation_lng >= -50 AND g.geolocation_lng < -45
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_point_in_box
  FROM sellers s
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = s.seller_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_state
)
SELECT
  seller_state,
  COUNT(*) AS total_sellers,
  SUM(has_point_in_box) AS sellers_in_box,
  SUM(has_point_in_box) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ratio_in_box
FROM flags
GROUP BY seller_state
ORDER BY ratio_in_box DESC, seller_state;

쿼리 작성: WITH flags AS (
  SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    s.seller_state,
    MAX(CASE WHEN g.geolocation_city LIKE '%-%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%0%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%1%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%2%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%3%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%4%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%5%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%6%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%7%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%8%'
                 OR g.geolocation_city LIKE '%9%'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_hyphen_or_digit
  FROM sellers s
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = s.seller_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_state
)
SELECT
  seller_state,
  COUNT(*) AS total_sellers,
  SUM(has_hyphen_or_digit) AS sellers_with_hyphen_or_digit
FROM flags
GROUP BY seller_state
ORDER BY sellers_with_hyphen_or_digit DESC, seller_state;

쿼리 작성: WITH city_pair AS (
  SELECT
    s.seller_city,
    g.geolocation_city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS seller_count
  FROM sellers s
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = s.seller_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY s.seller_city, g.geolocation_city
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    seller_city,
    geolocation_city,
    seller_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_city ORDER BY seller_count DESC, geolocation_city) AS rn
  FROM city_pair
)
SELECT
  seller_city,
  geolocation_city AS top_geolocation_city,
  seller_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY seller_count DESC, seller_city;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  g.geolocation_city,
  MIN(s.seller_state) AS seller_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM geolocation g
JOIN sellers s
  ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY g.geolocation_city
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_state) = 1
ORDER BY seller_count DESC, g.geolocation_city;

쿼리 작성: WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_coords,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(g.geolocation_city) = LOWER(s.seller_city) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_coords
  FROM sellers s
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = s.seller_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY s.seller_id
)
SELECT
  seller_id,
  total_coords,
  match_coords,
  match_coords * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_coords, 0) AS match_ratio
FROM stats
WHERE match_coords * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_coords, 0) >= 0.8
ORDER BY match_ratio DESC, seller_id;
